records.translation: Madarama mong handa kang harapin ang mundo!

records.source: Use this to create a cooking campfire, allowing you to cook on-the-go!
records.translation: Gamitin ito upang gumawa ng apoy na panluto at makapagluto saanman!

records.source: A common ore that can be smelted into bars.
records.translation: Karaniwang mineral na maaaring tunawin upang maging mga lingote.

records.source: There's copper ore in this stone.
records.translation: May mineral na tanso sa batong ito.

records.source: A colony of tiny creatures that clump together to form beautiful structures.
records.translation: Kolonya ng mumunting nilalang na nagkukumpol upang bumuo ng magagandang kayarian.

records.source: Slightly increases the size of your "fishing bar".
records.translation: Bahagyang pinalalaki ang iyong "bar ng pangingisda".

records.source: One of the most popular grains. The sweet, fresh cobs are a summer favorite.
records.translation: Isa sa pinakasikat na mga butil. Paborito sa tag-init ang matatamis at sariwang busal ng mais.

records.source: Plant these in the summer or fall. Takes 14 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tag-init o taglagas. Tumatagal ng 14 na araw upang mahinog at patuloy na namumunga matapos ang unang ani.

records.source: A marine crustacean with two powerful pincers.
records.translation: Hayop-dagat na may matigas na baluti at dalawang malalakas na sipit.

records.source: Crab, bread crumbs, and egg formed into patties then fried to a golden brown.
records.translation: Alimango, mumo ng tinapay, at itlog na hinubog na parang maliliit na keyk at pinirito hanggang maging ginintuang kayumanggi.

records.source: Place it in the water, load it with bait, and check the next day to see if you've caught anything. Works in streams, lakes, and the ocean.
records.translation: Ilagay ito sa tubig, lagyan ng Pain, at tingnan kinabukasan kung may nahuli. Gumagana sa mga batis, lawa, at karagatan.

records.source: The top of the ring is made from enchanted crab shell.
records.translation: Gawa sa inengkanto na talukab ng alimango ang tuktok ng singsing.

records.source: These tart red berries are a traditional winter food.
records.translation: Tradisyonal na pagkain sa taglamig ang maaasim na pulang berry na ito.
